## Maintainer checklist

- [ ] I personally verified the source, link, or reproduction.
- [ ] I preserved the upstream license and attribution requirements.
- [ ] I ran `./scripts/bootstrap.sh --check`.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate_catalog.py`.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check`.

AI tools may assist with formatting or search, but unverifiable AI-only changes
will not be merged.
